title: Accountability and Life's Value
summary: Humans must value life and prepare for accountability before Allah.
translation: One should value one's life. Whatever time, life, or age we have been given, we must remember that one day we will go to Allah. Allah will ask us, 'We gave you so much respite, so much time, what did you do for Us? We sent to you warning and glad tidings, that is, the Book of Allah, which is the Word of Allah. How much did you act upon it?' Therefore, there is a Hadith where the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, an angel will announce by the command of Allah on the Day of Judgment, 'Where are the people who were sixty years old?' meaning those who reached sixty years in this world should present themselves for the reckoning of their age. And this is the age concerning which Allah has said, 'Have We not given you such an age in which a person who would receive admonition and could understand it, indeed if such a person wanted to take it?' While a warner came to you. By 'a warner came,' it means that the Prophet ﷺ came or similarly other Prophets (peace be upon them) also arrived. So it became known that the orders and instructions of Allah are the things that are warning. The Holy Quran and its Messenger ﷺ are all those who warn the servant. It became known that a person whom Allah has granted such a long life and so many opportunities to turn towards the Hereafter, would be foolish and unfortunate if they fail to do anything for their Hereafter and worldly success, and waste such a long part of their life, leaving this world just like that. Therefore, think seriously about answering before Allah and the severity of the Day of Judgment. Allah will neither accept any excuse there nor any such thing that indicates an acceptable excuse for a person. Thus, one should pray to Allah and make every possible effort to attain His pleasure."
